dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: Hello. I'm the Parchamdar for the Corps of Thirty, in charge of the Eremites in Sumeru City.

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: Happy holidays, and hope you have fun! But please be careful too.

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: If you notice anything unusual, big or small, please inform the nearest member of the Corps of Thirty.
